title_candidates: Replit Free Mode lets anyone shape an app before spending credits
summary: Replit's new GPT-5.6 Luna-powered Free Mode lets people plan and refine software ideas without consuming usage before they enter a build mode.

primary_source.title: Replit expands access to software creation with GPT-5.6 Luna
primary_source.author: OpenAI
key_facts: Replit Free Mode is powered by GPT-5.6 Luna.
It supports answers, suggestions, feedback, and analysis without consuming usage.
Replit can route harder work to GPT-5.6 Sol while preserving project context.
Free Mode is intended to help people refine an idea before entering a build mode.

supporting_sources.title: Replit Starter Plan
key_facts: The free plan has daily Agent credits and a monthly cap.
It includes Lite build and one free published app that goes offline after 30 days.
Full build and third-party connectors require a paid plan.

supporting_sources.title: Build with Agent
key_facts: Replit recommends specific prompts, review and testing, and checkpoints.

prerequisites: A small app idea with no private data

steps.instruction: Create a disposable project and confirm that Free Mode is available before proceeding.
Ask for a bounded plan and acceptance checklist without editing files.
Remove accounts, payments, analytics, connectors, and personal data from the test scope.
Confirm mode, credit, and publishing limits before approving a build.
Test the preview against the checklist and roll back or delete a failed result.

references.title: Replit expands access to software creation with GPT-5.6 Luna
references.author: OpenAI

risk_flags: Free Mode does not make every build, connector, or deployment unlimited.
The guide tells readers to confirm the current mode and allowance before a build.
